# Code

[Project home](../../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Executable model functions, parameter readers and simulation tools.

`Simulation_Results/Intact_Walking/Simulation_Code_Used/Code`

| File or folder | Purpose and units |
| --- | --- |
| [model_configuration](model_configuration/README.md) | Code that defines parameter names, validates their organization and locates project files. To change physical values for a simulation, edit Data/Model_Parameters. |
| [neuromechanics](neuromechanics/README.md) | Functions that calculate excitation, activation, muscle and tendon forces, paw contact, coupled body motion and output comparisons. Each file represents a named part of the calculation. |
